Q1: How should this issue handle gap 1 (`_AI_ENGINE_EXIT_REFUSED` missing from `scripts/ai_engine.sh` on main)?
Choices:
A. Fix only gap 2 here. Gap 1 is closed when project #6664 merges #6667 through its own pipeline. The PR records this as an expected dependency hold and changes nothing in `scripts/ai_engine.sh` or `scripts/pr_dependency.py`. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Also port #6667's `_AI_ENGINE_EXIT_REFUSED` capacity-class change (`scripts/ai_engine.sh` and its callers) from `orchestrator/project-6664` onto main in this issue. This risks duplicating and conflicting with the open integration branch.
C. Fix only gap 2, and also comment on #6667 / tracking issue #6664 to say that the follow-up tracks are waiting on its merge. No code change for gap 1.
